Reference / crypto/x509/certificate

crypto/x509/certificate#

X.509 certificates read from DER: subject, issuer, validity, key, names and extensions.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let certificate = ParsedCertificate(der).certificate();
certificate.subject();
certificate.validity().ends();
certificate.names().dns();                  // subjectAltName DNS names
certificate.extensions().key_usages();

Description#

X.509 certificates read from DER: subject, issuer, validity, key, names and extensions.

Reading checks the DER envelope and decodes the certificate; it does not verify a signature or a chain (crypto/x509/trust does). Input is bounded: 1 MiB, 8192 DER nodes, nesting 32, 128 extensions.
